content.text:
**Cause found: the `monthly-spend-feature` flag going from `off` to `on`.**

Key evidence chain:
- Baseline through 14:17 with flag `off`: only sparse `UpstreamTimeout` errors at 0–3%.
- 14:18: `monthly-spend-feature=off 29 / on 171` — the rollout minute — and the first `ZeroDivisionError ... spend_summary.py:32`; error rate jumps to 27%.
- 14:19 onward: flag fully `on`, errors dominated by that ZeroDivisionError, 21–38%.
- No deploy or other change to io-shop in the month before onset (empty change window 2026-08-17 → 14:23).
- Why the earlier remediation "didn't help": the change log shows Argus switched the flag **off at 14:23:28** and then **on again at 14:26:32**, and logs at 14:26–14:27 still read `monthly-spend-feature=on` with the same ZeroDivisionError. The flag was left in the failing state, so the fix was never actually in effect.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: Enabling the feature flag monthly-spend-feature exposed a divide-by-zero bug in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32 on the account page, driving the error rate from ~1% to 21-38%. The earlier remediation appeared not to work because the flag was switched back on at 14:26:32 and left on, so the service was never actually running with the flag off.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-17T14:18:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32
2026-09-17T14:17:00Z INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations (only UpstreamTimeout errors, 'account page error rate at 1% over the last minute')

"summary": "feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on", "actor": "Argus" - the flag was re-enabled, and 2026-09-17T14:27:00Z INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=on with ZeroDivisionError still firing at 36%
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-08-17T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-17T14:23:00Z: (nothing changed in this window) - no deploy can account for onset

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: the divide-by-zero defect in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32 was shipped by an earlier code change and lay dormant until flag traffic reached it; the flag is the trigger, the faulty build the root fault. No deployment is recorded within the month before onset, so this rests only on the code path named in the error.
